notes: Each of the three substantival articles governs a prepositional phrase rather than a participle, so rule 32's own clause keeps the discontinuous them that on the article and sends the supplied copula to ἐν.
εἰς αὐτήν → therein is one aligned unit under rule 35, the -in realizing the preposition; reaching for noncompositional would be the recurring failure rule 35 names.
